claims.claim: H2DF matches GradDiff forget and retain NLL on TOFU while using retain replay only every tenth step.
claims.episode_span: On TOFU it matches GradDiff forget and retain NLL while cutting variability; on MUSE-News it improves retention over GA and NPO.
claims.source_title: H2DF: Calibrated Target Bands for Controllable Language-Model Unlearning
claims.supporting_quote: Across three TOFU seeds, H2DF obtains a forget NLL of 1.528 with margin 0.049 and retain NLL of 1.165 with margin 0.047, matching GradDiff while using retain replay only every tenth step and showing substantially lower variability than GA.

claims.claim: MoPE-LoRA yields a 12.3 % relative WER improvement over single LoRA in zero-shot accent transfer on L2-ARCTIC.
claims.episode_span: On L2-ARCTIC it delivers a 12.3 % relative WER improvement over single LoRA in the zero-shot setting.
claims.source_title: Mixture of Phonetic Experts Based Low-Rank Adaptation of Conformer Models for Accented English Speech Recognition
claims.supporting_quote: In zero-shot evaluation where one accent is held out during training, the proposed method yields a 12.3% relative improvement over single LoRA.

claims.claim: CERTA’s 4-bit frontier reduces amortized deployment cost to roughly 26 % of the BF16 baseline while staying under 48 GB.
claims.episode_span: the 4-bit frontier cut amortized cost to roughly 26 % of the BF16 baseline while staying under 48 GB.
claims.source_title: Do We Need the Largest LLMs for Every Clinical Decision?
claims.supporting_quote: In the same operational analysis, the class-conditional 4-bit frontier reduced the amortized, BF16-equivalent deployment cost to 25.8% and 27.3% of the BF16 reference for Qwen2.5-72B and HuatuoGPT-o1-72B, respectively, with measured peak memory of 43.0 and 42.7 GB, below the nominal capacity of a single 48 GB accelerator.
